reports.title: THE BALDWIN GROUP ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

desk.headline: Revenue up 31% to $480.3m, adjusted EPS $0.42 slightly below estimate; no outlook given ahead of $32.50 take-private

other.label: Organic revenue growth
other.change: vs 5% a year ago; 3% for nine months

other.label: GAAP net loss
other.change: vs -$30.2m a year ago; -$0.63 a share

results: Total revenue rose 31% to $480.3m, mostly thanks to the CAC Group acquisition; organic growth was 6%, up from 5% a year ago.
Adjusted EBITDA grew 47% to $106.9m and the margin widened 2.4 points to 22.2%.
Adjusted EPS rose to $0.42 from $0.31, but the GAAP net loss widened to $81.6m (-$0.63 a share) on higher amortisation, interest, earnout revaluation and $21.0m of take-private costs.
Operating cash flow was $54.2m and adjusted free cash flow rose 33% to $55.6m; cash stood at $188.6m with $289.1m of undrawn credit.
Headline numbers matched the preliminary results the company published on 26 October.

guidance.summary: The results release gives no outlook. Baldwin agreed in September to be bought by an investor group led by Sequence AI Holdings and DFO Management for $32.50 a share in cash, with closing expected in Q1 2027.

watch: Shareholder vote and regulatory approvals for the $32.50-a-share take-private, due to close in Q1 2027.
Whether organic growth holds near 6% after a 3% nine-month pace.
Earnout and tax-receivable liabilities, which rose sharply this year.
